session.question: How do the sustainability ideas in the supply chain management framework and the article on sustainable marketing both show how environmental sustainability can be advanced and linked to company image?
session.answer:
Both the supply chain management framework and the sustainable marketing article show that environmental sustainability is advanced when sustainability is operationalized rather than treated as a purely declarative goal. In the supply chain framework, sustainability is embedded in managerial and logistical decisions across the chain, so environmental and social responsibility becomes part of how the firm operates and is perceived externally; this integration helps translate sustainability intent into a credible company image. The article on sustainable marketing makes the same broader point from the consumer side: sustainability-oriented marketing improves brand/company image, and that image then increases customer engagement and sustainable purchase intention. In both cases, sustainability is linked to company image through visible practices and communication that signal responsible conduct rather than superficial claims. (jagani2025sustainabilityorientationsustainability chunk 1, gong2023howsustainablemarketing chunk 1)

The two perspectives also converge on the idea that company image is strengthened when sustainability is supported by concrete action and institutional consistency. The supply chain framework implies that sustainable sourcing, production, and coordination create legitimacy and trust in the firm’s image. The marketing study shows that this effect is stronger when corporate social responsibility (CSR) is present, because CSR amplifies the positive effect of sustainability-focused marketing on image and pro-sustainable behavior. Thus, environmental sustainability is advanced both by internal implementation in the supply chain and by external marketing/CSR signaling, with company image functioning as the mediating channel that converts sustainability efforts into market and behavioral outcomes. (jagani2025sustainabilityorientationsustainability chunk 1, gong2023howsustainablemarketing chunk 1)

session.context:
pqac-c07187af: The article argues that sustainable marketing helps advance environmental sustainability by aligning marketing with socio-ethical and sustainability goals such as environmental conservation. In its study of electric vehicle purchasers in China, the authors found that sustainable marketing improves brand/company image. That improved image then increases customer engagement and sustainable purchase intention. The paper also reports that corporate social responsibility (CSR) strengthens the relationship between company image and both customer engagement and sustainable purchase intentions, suggesting that sustainability-oriented marketing and CSR together make company image a more effective driver of pro-sustainable consumer behavior.
From Yanping Gong, Jun Xiao, Xiuyuan Tang, and Jinglu Li. How sustainable marketing influences the customer engagement and sustainable purchase intention? the moderating role of corporate social responsibility. Frontiers in Psychology, 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2023.1128686, doi:10.3389/fpsyg.2023.1128686.

pqac-2fdaf9f4: The article examines sustainability orientation, sustainability implementation, and brand image in service firms. It argues that environmental sustainability is advanced not just by stating a sustainability commitment, but by translating that intent into concrete, visible actions. Using data from 31 US service firms and 6,891 customers, the authors find that sustainability implementation strongly improves brand image, while sustainability orientation alone can have a negative direct effect on brand image if not backed by action. Implementation mediates the relationship between orientation and brand image, suggesting that genuine environmental and social practices help build a sustainable company image and avoid greenwashing perceptions.
From Sandeep Jagani and Vafa Saboorideilami. Sustainability orientation, sustainability implementation, and brand image in service firms. Business Strategy and the Environment, 2025. URL: https://doi.org/10.1002/bse.4273, doi:10.1002/bse.4273.

pqac-6d193243: The article argues that sustainability marketing can advance responsible sustainable consumer behavior by making environmental and social sustainability visible to customers. Using hotel customer data, it finds that a hotel’s brand image mediates the relationship between sustainability marketing and responsible sustainable consumer behavior: sustainability-focused marketing improves brand image, which in turn encourages more responsible behavior. The study also shows that corporate social responsibility strengthens this effect, meaning sustainability marketing has a stronger positive impact on brand image when the company is also actively engaged in CSR. Thus, environmental sustainability is linked to company image through sustainability marketing and CSR.
From Tong Jia, Shahid Iqbal, Arslan Ayub, Tehreem Fatima, and Zeeshan Rasool. Promoting responsible sustainable consumer behavior through sustainability marketing: the boundary effects of corporate social responsibility and brand image. Sustainability, 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.3390/su15076092, doi:10.3390/su15076092.

pqac-a7b3fa4c: The article argues that environmental sustainability is increasingly central to a company’s image because consumers are more environmentally conscious and prefer firms that reduce their environmental impact. It says sustainable marketing helps companies demonstrate responsibility toward the planet and society, which builds customer trust, loyalty, and a positive reputation. By adopting sustainable practices and offering eco-friendly products, businesses can strengthen brand identity, differentiate from competitors, and gain a competitive advantage. The study uses survey data and statistical testing to examine how sustainability shapes consumer perceptions of company image, concluding that sustainability can improve long-term success and profitability.
From Lucia Šujanská and Margaréta Nadányiová. Sustainable marketing and its impact on the image of the company. Marketing and Management of Innovations, 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.21272/mmi.2023.2-06, doi:10.21272/mmi.2023.2-06.

pqac-48dd4cc4: The article argues that social media marketing and marketing management can help build brand sustainability strategies. It says organizations increasingly use social media to share information with stakeholders, gather feedback, and collect data that supports sustainability planning. Because public awareness of sustainability is rising, these practices help firms develop practical sustainability strategies. The study also emphasizes that market managers are vital in ensuring business sustainability. Overall, the paper links sustainability efforts to communication and brand strategy, suggesting that environmental sustainability can be advanced through stakeholder engagement and integrated into a company’s image and long-term brand positioning.
From Ahmad Al Adwan and Ghaiath Altrjman. The role of social media marketing and marketing management promoting and developing brand sustainability strategy. International Journal of Data and Network Science, 2023. URL: https://doi.org/10.5267/j.ijdns.2023.9.011, doi:10.5267/j.ijdns.2023.9.011.

Sustainability is treated as having three dimensions: environment, economy, and society. The framework uses measures assessed through the “dashboard of 5 Ps” (Peace, People, Planet, Partnership, Prosperity) to show how ports can contribute to the SDGs. It highlights that ports can influence all SDGs directly or indirectly and that the framework is meant to help ports integrate economic and social goals with environmental concerns. By supporting the UN 2030 agenda internally and externally, the framework can strengthen a port’s sustainability performance and public image through visible environmental and social responsibility.

session.formatted_answer:
Question: How do the sustainability ideas in the supply chain management framework and the article on sustainable marketing both show how environmental sustainability can be advanced and linked to company image?

Both the supply chain management framework and the sustainable marketing article show that environmental sustainability is advanced when sustainability is operationalized rather than treated as a purely declarative goal. In the supply chain framework, sustainability is embedded in managerial and logistical decisions across the chain, so environmental and social responsibility becomes part of how the firm operates and is perceived externally; this integration helps translate sustainability intent into a credible company image. The article on sustainable marketing makes the same broader point from the consumer side: sustainability-oriented marketing improves brand/company image, and that image then increases customer engagement and sustainable purchase intention. In both cases, sustainability is linked to company image through visible practices and communication that signal responsible conduct rather than superficial claims. (jagani2025sustainabilityorientationsustainability chunk 1, gong2023howsustainablemarketing chunk 1)

The two perspectives also converge on the idea that company image is strengthened when sustainability is supported by concrete action and institutional consistency. The supply chain framework implies that sustainable sourcing, production, and coordination create legitimacy and trust in the firm’s image. The marketing study shows that this effect is stronger when corporate social responsibility (CSR) is present, because CSR amplifies the positive effect of sustainability-focused marketing on image and pro-sustainable behavior. Thus, environmental sustainability is advanced both by internal implementation in the supply chain and by external marketing/CSR signaling, with company image functioning as the mediating channel that converts sustainability efforts into market and behavioral outcomes. (jagani2025sustainabilityorientationsustainability chunk 1, gong2023howsustainablemarketing chunk 1)
